# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Almost fourteen  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)</sub>
- **Titles:** Medalist  <sub>[v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Hughie  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Hugh is a tall, terribly handsome youth who bears a striking resemblance to his father. He has wavy chestnut hair, mischievous light-brown or hazel eyes, and an attractive appearance.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c28 P32](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0032), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037)_

## Personality

Hugh is a smart youth with individual perspectives who teases girls mischievously and often grins mockingly or with humor. Despite his prankish nature, he possesses a generous, considerate, and self-denying character, seeking to extract the finest elements from life while contributing his utmost to it.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)_

## History

After returning to Brierley from Alberta and New Brunswick, Hugh joined the local school and engaged in a fierce but friendly academic rivalry with Nell Harcourt. Upon moving on to Regent’s Academy, he took the Second Year course in a single year to earn his teacher's license. At the end of his term, he successfully won the class medal. Needing to fund his own college education due to his father's illness, he planned to teach. Upon discovering that Nell wished to stay near home, he selflessly withdrew his application for the Brierley school so she could take it, choosing instead to teach at Pale Sands.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)_
